description: Nadeem Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is known as a producer of ring-spun yarn, which it describes as its core business; it presents itself as one of Pakistan's largest and most dynamic textile companies. It runs two mills — Unit 1 at S.I.T.E. Nooriabad and Unit 2 at S.I.T.E. Kotri, both in Sindh — with a workforce of over 1,500 and an in-house power generation plant supplying the mill. It sells yarn locally and regularly supplies Far East Asia, Europe, Turkey, South East Asia and South Asia.
headOffice: 801-804, Lakson Square Building No. 3-A, Sarwar Shaheed Road, Karachi, Pakistan

products.name: Knitwear yarn
products.summary: 100% cotton carded yarn for knitwear: single counts NE 8/1 to 32/1 and double counts NE 20/2 to 32/2, with twist per the customer's requirement.

products.name: Woven fabric yarn
products.summary: 100% cotton carded yarn for woven fabric: single counts NE 12/1 to 40/1 and double counts NE 32/2 to 60/2.

products.name: PC and CVC blended yarn
products.summary: Poly-cotton 52:48 yarn from 10/1 to 40/1 and chief-value-cotton 60:40 yarn from 16/1 to 30/1, plus PC 80:20 free-ratio qualities at 20/1, 30/1 and 40/1.

products.name: Terry towel yarn
products.summary: 100% cotton carded yarn for terry towelling: single counts NE 10/1 to 24/1 and double counts NE 20/2 to 40/2.

products.name: Denim yarn
products.summary: 100% cotton carded, slub and Siro yarn for denim: single counts NE 6/1 to 12/1 and double counts NE 12/2 to 30/2.

products.name: Heather grey yarn
products.summary: Poly-cotton melange (heather grey) knitting yarn in counts 16/1 to 30/1; the company also lists 100% pure polyester yarn from 16/1 to 40/1.
